{"answers":[{"question":"role","answer":"commands","quotes":[{"paragraph":"K3.P4","text":"3. CHILLED WATER PUMP DUTY/STANDBY CONTROL: THE CHILLED WATER PUMPS ARE CONFIGURED IN A MANNER THAT IF THE OPERATING DUTY PUMP SHOULD FAIL, AS SENSED BY A MISMATCH BETWE EN THE BMS'S CONTROLLED VALUE AND THE BMS STATUS MONITORED BY ASSOCIATED CURRENT SENSING RELAYS, THE BMS WOULD START THE STANDBY PUMP AND DISABLE THE FAILED PUMP FROM BMS CONTROLLED OPERATION. THE BMS SHALL AUTOMATICALLY ALTERNATE THE OPERATION OF THE DUTY AND STANDBY PUMP ON A LEA D - LAG ARRANGEMENT, BASED ON A RUN TIME SCHEDULE. HOA SETTINGS SHALL BE PROVIDED AS PART OF THE VARIABLE FREQUENCY DRIVE THROUGH THE DRIVE ’ S KEYPAD FOR THE CHILLED WATER PUMPS. WHEN IN THE HAND MODE,THE PUMP/S SHALL BE STARTED. IN THE OFF MODE THE PUMP(S) SHALL BE OFF. IN THE AUTO MODE, THE PUMP SHALL BE STARTED AND STOPPED THROUGH THE BMS."},{"paragraph":"K3.P5","text":"4. CHILLED WATER PUMP SPEED CONTROL: THE BMS MODULATES THE DUTY CHILLED WATER PUMP TO MAINTAIN DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE, AS SENSED BY A DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE SENSOR CONNECTED BETWEEN THE SUPPLY AND RETURN CHILLED WATER PIPING. THE DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE SENSOR SHALL BE LOCATED IN A LOCATION TO ENSURE DESIGN FLOW AT FURTEST RUNS. MULTIPLE DIFFERNTIAL PRESSURE SENSORS SHALL BE USED IN MULTIPLE BRANCHES WITH BMS PID CONTROLLING FOR WORST CASE. LOCAL - REMOTE SETTINGS SHALL BE PROVIDED AS PART OF THE VARIABLE FREQUENCY DRIVE THROUGH THE DRIVE'S KEYPAD FOR EACH PUMP. IN THE LOCAL MODE, THE PUMP SPEED SHALL BE CON TROLLED THROUGH A MANUAL SPEED CONTROL LOCATED AT THE DRIVE CONTROL PANEL. IN THE REMOTE MODE, THE PUMP SPEED SHALL BE CONTROLLED BY THE BMS."}],"subject_quote":{"paragraph":"K3.P4","text":"THE BMS WOULD START THE STANDBY PUMP AND DISABLE THE FAILED PUMP"}}]}
